text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and I are walking through the park when she comes to a sudden stop and becomes transfixed by a lady looking out over the water.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …! Is that? No, it can't be…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, pardon me. There's simply no way that—but then again, the resemblance is so uncanny…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …It must be her. That lady is a stage actress I saw perform in my youth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I believe she has yet to retire… I remember watching her and being mesmerized by her stage presence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To think I'd see her here of all places… What a peculiar feeling. It's as if I'm reliving my childhood.
choice_data_list: Why don't you go say hi?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, but… it would be dreadfully rude to strike up a conversation with her out of the blue. Especially considering she's off the clock at the moment…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you… certain? I would be as polite and respectful as possible, of course…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Very well. I shall allow myself to become a child once again… and relive my memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's rare for Mejiro Ardan to look this giddy. Watching her talk with the stage actress from a distance, I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Thank you for your patience, Trainer. I had a wonderful time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter? You have quite a bewildered look in your eye…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh?! G-Goodness, what am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Whew… I don't know what came over me…
choice_data_list: Is it because you let yourself be a child again?
Is it because you let yourself be a child again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Th-that can't be right… I was never the sort of child to express my excitement physically.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Unless, no, surely not… Was that spontaneous movement just now the first time I've done it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's taken me by surprise as well. To think that my body would move on its own like that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Still… perplexing movements aside, it appears that reviving distant memories is a wonderful thing indeed.
choice_data_list: …It's nice to let your inner child out sometimes, isn't it?
…It's nice to let your inner child out sometimes, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is. Back then, I'd watch these worlds unfolding up on the stage and feel my heart pounding with excitement…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah… Trainer, please refrain from teasing me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm not a child anymore. It's no use indulging in such juvenile whims.
choice_data_list: Or you could just go ahead and have some fun.
Nostalgia's something you can enjoy because you've matured.
Nostalgia's something you can enjoy because you've matured.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm not a child anymore. It's no use indulging in such juvenile whims.
choice_data_list: Or you could just go ahead and have some fun.
Nostalgia's something you can enjoy because you've matured.
Nostalgia's something you can enjoy because you've matured.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Have some fun… Actually, in that sense, I think it would be all right…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …But if I were to have some fun, I think I'd be more comfortable doing so with some company.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… If you're willing to accompany me, Trainer, I believe I'll have myself some fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. You're really quite good at skipping, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us relax by letting our inner doofuses out for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I can see the logic in that.
choice_data_list: It shows that you've come out of your shell, so to speak.
It shows that you've come out of your shell, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. When put in those terms, this sort of behavior does indicate a love for—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Ah, this really is rather embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I come to discover a side to Mejiro Ardan that takes me by surprise—and it's one she wasn't aware of herself either.
